newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Lepanto shares higher on mining output news.
newsitem.headline: Lepanto shares higher on mining output news.

text.p: Lepanto Consolidated Mining Co A gained five centavos, or 9.43 percent, to 58 centavos in mid-session on Thursday as investors reacted to news of gold and silver output from its Victorias gold mine, brokers said.
"It's due to those production figures," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities.
"It was the valuation of gold and silver from the Victoria project that is pushing the price of the stock higher," said Elline Salvatierra, analyst at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.

On Wednesday, Lepanto president Artemio Disini said total value of gold and silver extracted from its Victoria gold mine in Benguet province northern Philippines reached 222.34 million pesos for the first five months of the year.
Lepanto had earlier forecast a net income of 648 million pesos this year with the start of operation of its Victoria project. It made 45.7 million pesos in 1996.
Lepanto B shares rose three centavos, or 4.23 percent, to 74 centavos.
The mining sub-index posted the biggest gain among the market's six sub-indices, climbing 4.37 percent to 4,311.12 points in mid-session.
